analysis.session_summary: The overnight tape was a broad USD bid: USD rose against all majors, with DXY up 0.22% to 99.301 and USD strength mean +0.279% vs majors. EUR/USD fell 23.2 pips to 1.15369, GBP/USD fell 21.6 pips to 1.34837, and NZD/USD fell 32.0 pips to 0.57552, while USD/JPY rose 41.8 pips to 154.737. Brent/USD gained 1.405% and SPX fell 0.573%, but the IRGC tanker fire, China steady-economy headlines, and Japan ITA were all too weak to own the moves. No measured event reactions were available.

themes.theme: Broad USD strength without clear event catalyst
themes.evidence: USD mean vs majors +0.279%; DXY +0.22% to 99.301; USD/JPY +0.271%; USD/CHF +0.325%; EUR/USD -0.201%; GBP/USD -0.160%.

themes.theme: Commodity FX underperformance despite firmer oil
themes.evidence: Brent/USD +1.405%; NZD/USD -0.553%; AUD/USD -0.362%; USD/NOK +0.325%; USD/SEK +0.477%; USD/CAD +0.077%.
SPX -0.573%; VIX moved higher to 18.48595; JPY strength -0.03%; CHF strength -0.091%; USD/ZAR +0.414%; USD/MXN +0.258%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: Two down legs (-11.9 and -14.7 pips) separated by a small 5.2-pip bounce left EUR/USD down 23.2 pips at the 0.08 low of a 26.5-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: Down legs of -15.5 and -20.6 pips dominated a 30.9-pip range, with only a 8.6-pip bounce; no clear news catalyst and close at 0.04 range.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: An early -34.1-pip drop was fully reversed by a 71.0-pip up leg into an 89.7-pip range, closing at 0.83; no news catalyst.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: A flat first leg (+0.4) was overwhelmed by a -24.2-pip slide; no clear catalyst, with close at 0.12 of a 29.7-pip range.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: A -13.9-pip drop, a 9.4-pip bounce, then a -25.1-pip leg left NZD/USD down 32.0 pips at 0.10 of a 35.7-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: Two up legs (15.5 and 17.8 pips) outweighed an 11.6-pip dip; no clear catalyst, closing near the high at 0.95 of a 28.9-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: A 5.0-pip up leg, -7.5-pip dip, then 16.2-pip up leg produced a 10.7-pip net gain; close at 0.87 of an 18.9-pip range, no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: An 8.1-pip rise, -10.6-pip dip, then 9.9-pip rise left EUR/CHF up 11.5 pips at 0.85 of a 13.7-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: A -47.9-pip drop, 59.6-pip rally, then -16.6-pip fade left CHF/JPY down 10.3 pips; close at 0.72 of a 65.7-pip range, no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.AUD/NZD: A 10.3-pip up leg, -24.4-pip dip, then 47.7-pip rally and -11.4-pip fade left AUD/NZD up 23.7 pips at 0.75 of a 58.1-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: Small alternating legs within 8.1 pips left EUR/GBP down 3.7 pips at 0.51 of its range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.AUD/CHF: Up/down/up/down legs within 14.3 pips left AUD/CHF down 2.1 pips at 0.25 of its range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.NZD/CHF: A 2.4-pip up, -13.9-pip down, 14.5-pip up, then -14.7-pip down left NZD/CHF down 11.0 pips at 0.14 of a 17.5-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/SEK: A 253.2-pip up, -812.4-pip down, then 978.8-pip up left USD/SEK up 464.0 pips at 0.99 of a 1032.6-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/NOK: A 236.4-pip up, -260.6-pip down, then 308.4-pip up left USD/NOK up 302.7 pips at 0.94 of a 346.5-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/ZAR: Up/down/up legs of 269.1, -248.1, and 562.0 pips left USD/ZAR up 671.0 pips at 1.00 of a 678.9-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/MXN: Up/down/up legs of 369.7, -266.2, and 339.5 pips left USD/MXN up 442.2 pips at 0.99 of a 494.9-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.Brent/USD: A -122.0-pip early dip followed by a 241.7-pip rally left Brent/USD up 151.2 pips at 0.98 of a 434.8-pip range; no clear catalyst.

scenarios.name: Dollar bid extends on soft UK data
scenarios.thesis: The overnight USD bid persists and UK labor data disappoints, pushing GBP/USD lower and EUR/GBP higher as sterling underperforms.
scenarios.invalidation: GBP/USD recovers above 1.34837 and EUR/GBP falls below 0.85558 on strong UK data.

pair_paths.rationale: GBP underperformance; 30.9-pip observed range sets the expected move.
EUR/GBP range was 8.1 pips; soft GBP could push it higher.
USD strength continues; 26.5-pip range from overnight.

scenarios.name: GBP data stabilizes cable, USD rally pauses
scenarios.thesis: UK data comes in firm enough to lift GBP/USD and cap EUR/GBP, while the broad USD bid pauses near session highs.
triggers: Claimant Count Change near or below 8.3K forecast
scenarios.invalidation: GBP/USD slides through 1.34837 and DXY extends above 99.301.

pair_paths.rationale: Potential bounce to upper end of 30.9-pip range.
EUR/GBP range 8.1 pips; GBP strength can push it lower.
USD pause leaves EUR/USD within 26.5-pip range.

scenarios.name: Oil risk premium jumps, commodity FX slides
scenarios.thesis: Hormuz tanker fire headlines escalate oil supply concern, lifting Brent further and hitting commodity currencies, while USD stays bid.
scenarios.invalidation: Brent/USD retreats below 109.144 and commodity FX recovers.

pair_paths.rationale: NZD/USD 35.7-pip range with close at 0.10; downside risk.
AUD/USD 29.7-pip range with close 0.12; downside risk.
Oil rise could support CAD, limiting USD/CAD despite USD bid; 18.9-pip range.

risks.risk: Strait of Hormuz tanker fire escalation
risks.why_it_matters: Brent/USD already rose 1.405% overnight and VIX moved higher; escalation could extend oil-driven USD demand and risk-off.
risks.watch: Brent/USD 109.144 close and VIX 18.48595; headline flow on tanker fire.

risks.why_it_matters: High-impact Claimant Count Change at 08:00 (forecast 8.3K vs previous -11.0K) can reprice GBP/USD and EUR/GBP.
risks.watch: GBP/USD 1.34837 and EUR/GBP 0.85558, with Claimant Count and Average Earnings.

risks.risk: Flow-driven USD strength without clear catalyst
risks.why_it_matters: USD mean vs majors +0.279% and DXY +0.22% occurred on no clear news, suggesting position adjustment; could continue or reverse sharply.
risks.watch: DXY 99.301 and EUR/USD 1.15369; if EUR/USD reclaims 1.15369, USD bid may fade.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: The only high/medium-risk calendar items in the near window are GBP Claimant Count Change at 08:00 (forecast 8.3K vs previous -11.0K) and Average Earnings Index 3m/y (forecast 3.9% vs previous 4.1%). A materially weaker UK labor report would reinforce the USD bid and pressure GBP/USD; a firm report could stabilize cable and slow the dollar. No US or major central bank events are scheduled until later.
